verdict.rationale: NRQL is documented as New Relic's SQL-like query language for querying its data. The docs say it answers specific troubleshooting and business questions ad hoc and powers the built-in charts, dashboards and alerts. It is also reachable through the nr1 CLI (`nr1 nrql`), the NerdGraph API, and AI assistance that translates plain English into NRQL. A community user confirms routinely running queries and getting graphs. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of NRQL syntax and reference depth (functions, clauses), and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of ad hoc analysis.
